mcp:tool-listener.name: orchestrate-employee-onboarding
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: Onboarding Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Complete employee onboarding orchestration including profile creation, asset allocation, and notifications
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:parameters-schema: { "type": "object", "properties": { "firstName": {"type": "string", "description": "Employee first name"}, "lastName": {"type": "string", "description": "Employee last name"}, "email": {"type": "string", "format": "email", "description": "Employee email address"}, "phone": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[+]?[1-9]\\d{1,14}$", "description": "Employee phone number"}, "department": {"type": "string", "enum": ["HR", "IT", "Finance", "Sales", "Marketing", "Operations", "Engineering"], "description": "Department name"}, "position": {"type": "string", "description": "Job position/title"}, "startDate": {"type": "string", "format": "date", "description": "Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format"}, "salary": {"type": "number", "minimum": 0, "description": "Annual salary"}, "manager": {"type": "string", "description": "Manager name"}, "managerEmail": {"type": "string", "format": "email", "description": "Manager email address"}, "companyName": {"type": "string", "description": "Company name"}, "assets": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}, "description": "List of assets to allocate"} }, "required": ["firstName", "lastName", "email", "department", "position", "startDate"] }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { content: [{"type": "text", text: "Onboarding failed: " ++ error.description}], isError: true }
